clause_evidence.reasoning: All twenty samples in the set present authentic mathematical problems with clear questions requiring solution. Each sample provides specific measurements and asks learners to determine the perimeter, demonstrating comprehensive coverage of problem-solving across multiple shape types and contexts.

Every sample explicitly focuses on calculating perimeter, whether through direct addition of all sides for triangles or applying formulas for squares and rectangles. The hints consistently define perimeter as the total distance around a shape, and all problems require learners to determine this specific measurement.

The sample set includes eight distinct triangle problems with varying side lengths and proportions. These triangles are featured in problems asking learners to add all three sides to determine perimeter, directly addressing the curriculum requirement to solve perimeter problems for this shape type.

Seven samples present rectangular gardens with different length and width combinations, from a six by two meter rectangle to an eight by one meter rectangle. These samples require learners to apply the rectangular perimeter formula, ensuring full coverage of solving perimeter problems for rectangles.
